cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(contour_vision LANGUAGES CXX)
add_library(contour_cimg SHARED cimg_bridge.cpp)
if(WIN32)
  set_target_properties(contour_cimg PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
endif()
target_compile_features(contour_cimg PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
set_target_properties(contour_cimg PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bin" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bin")
foreach(config RELEASE DEBUG RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
  set_target_properties(contour_cimg PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${config} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bin" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${config} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bin")
endforeach()
